age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

amount.description: Amount checked; null when omitted (amount checks skipped)

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

max_sendable.description: Most the source's balance allows it to send now, rounded down (freezes, limits and authorization are reported as reasons, not deducted); for an MPT issuer, the room left below the maximum amount; null when the source is the issuer of a trust-line token or when unknown

currency_ascii.description: Readable text of a 40-hex currency code; null when not printable ASCII; absent for XRP and 3-character codes

required_source_balance.description: Balance the source must hold for `amount`: XRP adds the larger of the reserve and the fee, a token sent between two holders adds the transfer fee (an MPT rounds up to whole base units); null without `amount` or when unknown

spendable_xrp.description: Source XRP above the larger of its live reserve and the standard fee; null when not computable

transfer_fee_pct.description: Issuer transfer fee in percent, when it applies

verdict.description: `not_ready` on any blocking reason; else `unknown` on any failed sub-check

description: Pre-payment check: can this payment from source to destination succeed now? When to use: Right before sending a payment: to catch a missing or unfunded destination, a required destination tag, deposit authorization, missing or frozen trust lines, MPT authorization and locks, insufficient balance and issuer freezes, in one call. Prefer another tool: To find a multi-hop route or the source amount needed for a cross-currency payment (use the paths endpoint), or to list balances (use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/summary`). Example: xrpl_payment_readiness {"source":"rvYAfWj5gh67oV6fW32ZzP3Aw4Eubs59B","destination":"rhub8VRN55s94qWKDv6jmDy1pUykJzF3wq"} Paid: 0.04356 USDC or 0.0363 EURC per call on Solana mainnet, VAT included. With prepaid credits, debit per call: 0.03 EUR-denominated units (approx 33 calls per bundle) or 0.036 USD-denominated units (approx 22 calls per bundle).

amount.description: Positive decimal amount of asset (whole base units for an MPT); omit to skip amount-dependent checks

asset.description: Asset to deliver; default XRP. `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code. Or a 48-hex MPT issuance id (hex letters in either case), with `amount` in whole base units.

credentials.description: Comma-separated Credential entry IDs (1 to 8, 64 hex); checked with deposit_authorized

destination.description: Receiving account: valid classic XRPL address, different from source

destination_tag.description: Destination tag you will send: an integer from 0 to 4294967295

source.description: Sending account: valid classic XRPL address (r..., checksum verified)
